operative_context: ## 2.1.1 The system shall allow authenticated users to create a rent request for an available rentable item.
Upon reaching the rental end date, the system shall update the rent status to 'Maintenance'
The system shall maintain the full lifecycle history of each rent record
exceptions: The system shall allow authorized users to cancel rent records that are in Approved or Active status
The system shall allow modification of rent records only when the rent status is Requested
The system shall prevent modification of rent records that are in Approved, Active, Completed, Rejected, or Cancelled status, unless explicitly permitted
conflicts_or_obsolete: Earlier lifecycle guidance may have included an operator tolerance window for early cancellation without penalty, but this exemption language is not present in the current v1.2 specification
